calibration.method: Platt sigmoid on raw random-forest probability log-odds; 5-fold GroupKFold out-of-fold development scores; equal total sample weight per scenario
calibration.adoption_rule: Adopt only if nested group-held-out development Brier improves by at least 0.001 and log loss is no more than 0.01 worse.

development_oof_raw.ece_method: 10 fixed-width [0,1] bins; empty bins omitted from weighted sum; bin counts retained

development_nested_group_cv_calibrated.ece_method: 10 fixed-width [0,1] bins; empty bins omitted from weighted sum; bin counts retained

final_held_out_raw.ece_method: 10 fixed-width [0,1] bins; empty bins omitted from weighted sum; bin counts retained

final_held_out_platt.ece_method: 10 fixed-width [0,1] bins; empty bins omitted from weighted sum; bin counts retained

calibration.probability_scope: Synthetic simulator label only; not real-world flood probability.

newly_exposed.definition: current footprint max depth <0.05 m and future target is exposure within 30 simulated minutes

held_out_failure_analysis.dependence_note: Building-tick rows within a scenario are repeated and spatially related; subgroup counts are descriptive and do not imply independent observations.

distribution_support.method: Per-feature training/development min-max plus 0.5th/99.5th percentile tail flags; missing, invalid, and schema mismatch have separate states.
distribution_support.limitations: Marginal support only; correlations can be implausible while every feature remains individually in range. In-support does not guarantee accuracy; this is not an independently validated hazard score.

performance.measurement_note: Warmed local process timing; environment-specific; batch covers one generated city.
